name: wallpaper
description: A moving wallpaper and matching colors for the whole app: Kiki (pixel art of a young witch and her black cat floating on a broom toward a seaside city, following your clock from day to sunset to night), a black hole in ASCII art drawn by code (a gold ring, its disc bent over and under it, everything streaming in), or a picture or short video loop of your own. /wallpaper settings sets how see-through and blurred the panels are.

spinner.title: Spinner: cat face
spinner.description: Adds a small cat face to the line that shows while Claude works, in the Kiki theme.
